title: Concerning the Three Rocks
text:
⟨p.155⟩

62 > Concerning the Three Rocks < 62
Once again he said to his disciples: "Three great
rocks exist, having been appointed by the Greatness; they were placed in
the worlds that are outside. The first indeed of the rocks is the
{3} of Glory, the Perfect Man, whom they summoned forth
{5} the Ambassador, the glorious one. He placed him in a Zone.
{6}{7} set his foot from below to above; he bears upward the cosm-
{8} entire one. He became foremost of all the heaven-bearers in
{9} powers. In his strength he raised himself upward; he established
all the {10} of those above and those below.
{11}second of the great rocks, the glorious, is the new land
of light, which they placed upon the land of darkness. He humbled
the stings of the rear of the storehouse of death. He prepared the
strengthening, in great firmness of the outer side, upon the land of darkness.
He pressed, he submerged, he stung the root of death.
{12}third of the rocks is the great Thought, whom he summoned
forth — Jesus the Glorious One. He placed him in the holy
Church; the Church gathered inward unto him; she lives in
{13}; she stands fast in a true standing-fast forever.
{14} are the three great rocks that came forth out of a great
{16}trust, in three great places, being honored. They were appointed,
they were spread forth in three great places of the worlds, {17}
{18}themselves; they were established according to the purpose-of-heart of the Greatness.
